{{Top|leg}}
The '''Worker sector''' was one of the two sectors of [[New Apsolon (city)|New Apsolon]]. Its inhabitants were called [[Workers|the Workers]], the poorer inhabitants of New Apsolon. Most of the buildings were build cheap, using durasteel or the native gray stone. The crudely built buildings offered no heat during the winter. None of the buildings were higher than six stories. The sector had been closed in by an [[energy wall]] until it was taken down after the [[Revolution on Apsolon|revolution]].

==History==
For years the inhabitants of the Worker sector had been suppressed by [[Civilized|the Civilized]] and their secret police, [[Absolutes|the Absolutes]]. In [[47 BBY/Legends|47 BBY]] they rebelled against their oppressors and managed to install a democratic system on the planet. [[Workers memorials|Memorials]], consisting of lighted glass, were placed on the places where Workers had been arrested or killed by the Absolutes. When [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] visited the sector in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]] he remarked that it was much cleaner and better maintained than six years before, although it still was in stark contrast to the [[Civilized sector]].
